# pve_node_reboot (Action)

Reboots a cluster node via `POST /nodes/{node}/status` (upstream `command: reboot`). **Destructive:** the node goes down immediately and every guest running on it is interrupted; only HA-managed guests are relocated to other nodes. Requires the `Sys.PowerMgmt` privilege on `/nodes/{node}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Destructive: reboots node pve1 immediately. Guests running on pve1 are
# interrupted unless HA relocates them. Invoke with:
#   terraform apply -invoke pve_node_reboot.reboot_pve1
invoke "pve_node_reboot" "reboot_pve1" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name to reboot.
